activity.notes: The interval begins with Rosenberg's documented furnishing of industrial secrets to Soviet intelligence in late 1942 and ends with his arrest in July 1950. ATLAS records the historically documented espionage activity rather than using his later trial or execution as the representative Activity.

sources.citation_text: The U.S. National Archives states that Julius Rosenberg began furnishing industrial secrets to the Soviets in late 1942 and describes the subsequent atomic espionage case.

sources.title: Atom Spy Case/Rosenbergs | FBI
sources.citation_text: The FBI records that a complaint charging Julius Rosenberg with espionage conspiracy was filed on July 17, 1950 and that he was arrested the same day.
